_readme: IdentityName, Publisher and PublisherDisplayName come from Partner Center > Product management > Product identity and must match exactly. Pro is sold as Subscription add-ons whose Product ID starts with ProProductIdPrefix (e.g. pro_monthly, pro_yearly). DisplayName must match the reserved app name exactly, including case (Partner Center shows 'swifttill').
Description: Swifttill — fast, simple point-of-sale for small shops: barcode sales, receipts, stock, customer credit (khata) and daily reports.
